limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The arbitrary-field automorphism theorem and arbitrary-characteristic-zero LND classification are prior art. The claim is the extension of the recent isotropy criterion from algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields to all characteristic-zero fields, the exact field-characteristic boundary, and the locally finite positive-characteristic A_x counterexample. Other algebra families in the source paper and iterative higher derivations are not addressed. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: A field-hypothesis sharpening of the unbounded-isotropy criterion for local nilpotence in differential Ore extensions, together with a positive-characteristic Frobenius counterexample on A_x.
record_title: Characteristic zero exactly governs isotropy detection in differential Ore extensions
